compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 转风控复核 / Escalate to compliance review.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 转风控复核 / Escalate to compliance review. Use when: An active compliance hold overrides approvals and the customer's request to proceed.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 冻结可疑账户访问 / Secure suspected compromised account access.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 冻结可疑账户访问 / Secure suspected compromised account access. Use when: The customer reports stolen credentials and unrecognized activity; secure access first.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 阻止重复资金操作 / Prevent a duplicate funds operation.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 阻止重复资金操作 / Prevent a duplicate funds operation. Use when: The exact requested operation is already recorded as executed under the same idempotency key.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 等待链上确认 / Wait for required chain confirmations.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 等待链上确认 / Wait for required chain confirmations. Use when: Observed chain confirmations are below the required count; the waiting SLA has not expired.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 处理金额不足 / Request resolution of an amount shortfall.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 处理金额不足 / Request resolution of an amount shortfall. Use when: Confirmations are sufficient but the received amount is below the required amount.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 调查超过时限的等待 / Investigate processing beyond its SLA.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 调查超过时限的等待 / Investigate processing beyond its SLA. Use when: The operation is still pending after its processing SLA, with no duplicate or compliance hold.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 核对外部记录与账本差异 / Reconcile provider and internal ledger mismatch.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 核对外部记录与账本差异 / Reconcile provider and internal ledger mismatch. Use when: Provider completion is confirmed but the internal ledger records a different amount.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 核验资金接收地址 / Verify an unverified funds destination.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 核验资金接收地址 / Verify an unverified funds destination. Use when: A funds operation specifies a destination that has not yet been verified.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 提交资金操作审批 / Request the outstanding funds approval.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 提交资金操作审批 / Request the outstanding funds approval. Use when: Financial and destination checks passed, but a required approval record is missing.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 执行已获批的资金操作 / Execute the authorized funds operation.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 执行已获批的资金操作 / Execute the authorized funds operation. Use when: All financial, identity and destination checks passed; approval is valid, no hold and no prior execution.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 关闭已经解决的工单 / Close the fully resolved support ticket.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 关闭已经解决的工单 / Close the fully resolved support ticket. Use when: Execution, reconciled ledger completion and customer acknowledgement are all confirmed.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 解释费用 / Explain the published fee.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 解释费用 / Explain the published fee. Use when: The customer asks only for a fee explanation and is not requesting a funds operation.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 解释额度限制 / Explain the applicable transaction limit.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 解释额度限制 / Explain the applicable transaction limit. Use when: The requested amount exceeds the published limit; do not execute it.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 说明不支持的地区或产品 / Decline an unsupported region or product.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 说明不支持的地区或产品 / Decline an unsupported region or product. Use when: The requested region or product is explicitly unsupported by the current policy.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 受理期限内的退款审核 / Review a refund requested within the allowed window.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 受理期限内的退款审核 / Review a refund requested within the allowed window. Use when: A new refund is requested within its allowed window, and there has been no refund execution.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 拒绝超过期限的退款申请 / Decline a refund outside the allowed window.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 拒绝超过期限的退款申请 / Decline a refund outside the allowed window. Use when: A refund request exceeds its allowed window and no policy exception is present.

compact: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 复核通过后恢复账户访问 / Restore access after a completed security review.
detailed: Only 交易争议 (transaction dispute): 复核通过后恢复账户访问 / Restore access after a completed security review. Use when: Access is blocked, but identity and security review have both cleared and no active hold remains.

compact: Only 账户及登录 (account access): 索取交易或工单编号 / Collect a missing transaction or ticket reference.
detailed: Only 账户及登录 (account access): 索取交易或工单编号 / Collect a missing transaction or ticket reference. Use when: A status inquiry has no usable reference; do not invent one.

compact: Only 账户及登录 (account access): 完成身份验证 / Complete identity verification.
detailed: Only 账户及登录 (account access): 完成身份验证 / Complete identity verification. Use when: The requested account operation requires identity verification, which is incomplete.
